The camera, narrow box proportions, front/top/right face outlines and full silhouette MUST remain exactly as reference. Do not make any face wider or taller and do not zoom. Same1254 canvas, exact outline x271..985 y114..1155, overall714w1041h. Keep the physical box silhouette FIXED; this is a printed-surface replacement ONLY. Same narrow right face (seam aboutx880), shallow top and slopes of front top and bottom, same paper texture, folds and light. Replace ALL the DOBAJ/vanilla printing and ivory/black paper color with this AFSAAL LYCHEE ORIGINAL print design: whole carton front, top, right is light muted sage / lychee green (#C9D6A0 family); top/right shading consistent. Upper front has a fine dark charcoal-plum sunrise-in-arch logo (an arch outline encloses a semicircle sun with straight rays above two simple curved horizon lines). Below it around upper-middle is maker name exactly AFSAAL in large elegantly spaced ROMAN UPPERCASE serif type in dark charcoal-plum. A single thin warm apricot diagonal ribbon crosses the lower half from upper-left toward lower-right, behind large flat angular red/coral lychee shell plus cut half with ivory flesh and brown seed, inside an ivory off-center circular field. Place spaced serif word LYCHEE at lower front left in dark charcoal-plum. Right face has a small maker logo, AFSAAL and LYCHEE. No Japanese, no DOBAJ logo, no vanilla, no leaves. Flat independently designed geometric screen-print flavor graphics on the paper surface; not a real commercial packaging copy, no ingredient photographs. Only change INK AND PAPER COLOR; keep original reference physical geometry unchanged. No grass, HMD, top protrusion, handle, loose fruit/flowers outside carton. One isolated whole carton with true transparent background, no captions or extra objects.

Entire front/top/right paper body must be muted DUSTY ROSE PINK (#B05B75 family), with ivory maker mark and lettering, cream/darker-pink flat angular rose petals; flavor word ROSE. The two AFSAAL flavors have different FULL-BOX COLORS. No leaves or real ingredient photos. Match REFERENCE1's exact narrower box camera and silhouette.
